summary: Rebuilt ERRORS from the docs catalog (domain pages, with errors-amendments overriding BIL-102 and ORD-204, and the 2025 archive ignored), including deprecated AUTH-006 and INV-305 mapped to AUTH-002 and INV-302. The docs server only returns one matching line per search, so I found codes by probing each code number in every domain's range. A code outside the ranges I probed could have been missed.
